cases.rationale: The foreground child and background people are actual people. The red kite in the child's hand and several airborne kite bodies/lines support kite presence; the flag and flying kite shapes are not actual birds or aircraft. The large white canopy is a marquee/tent rather than an identifiable umbrella. At the crowded lower-right edge, dark seating-like parts behind people could be an individual chair, but the crop does not resolve them from adjacent supports or equipment, so chair is unclear. After considering each of the 75 definitions, no other actual defined object is supported.

A man wears a real necktie, holds a white drinking cup in his left hand, and supports a long open dessert bowl in his right hand. The bowl contains whipped/ice-cream-like dessert with red cherries; this does not establish cake or any other listed baked food. A pale yellow curved portion along the dessert's right side could be banana but is too occluded to establish fruit identity, so banana is unclear. The wall notices and shirt illustration are printed material, not actual depicted category objects or bound books. All 75 definitions were considered; the other categories have no supported actual object.

The central round marbled cheesecake, with a removed wedge and crumb crust, is cake under the explicit cheesecake inclusion. The cut citrus at the top has an orange peel and orange segmented flesh, supporting orange. The white serving surface is a flat decorated plate, not a bowl. A reflective utensil is partly visible along the cake's left edge, but its working end is occluded and I cannot resolve fork, knife, or spoon; those three categories remain unclear. The very tight food crop supplies no identifiable dining-table structure/context beyond a plate on patterned material. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered; the remaining categories are no.

The large green refuse-collection vehicle has an identifiable truck body and wheel; the blue canopy on a central upright is an actual umbrella. At the truck's lower-left side, a tiny partly occluded dark upright shape with a light patch could be a worker, but the crop does not resolve it from mechanical parts, so person is unclear. The white labeled tub at the bottom is a bucket/container rather than a drinking cup. The rows of small colored bottle-like shapes on the cart's sign are printed illustrations rather than actual bottles. Boxes, bins and cart equipment do not establish the listed appliances or furniture. Each of the 75 definitions was considered.

A full-size passenger airplane fills the apron scene with clearly identifiable engines, fuselage and tail. Small workers in high-visibility clothing are actual people. The two white road vehicles in the foreground have enclosed passenger-van/car bodies and windows, supporting car. The mobile stairs, open towing/platform equipment and apron barriers do not establish a truck, bus, train, bench or chair. Aircraft insignia and printed markings are excluded as depicted objects. All 75 definitions were individually considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

An open laptop includes an integrated screen, base and clearly visible computer keyboard; a separate white computer mouse sits below it. The integrated display is laptop rather than standalone TV/monitor, and desktop icons are not physical depicted objects. White printed material in the open packaging at bottom right could be a small bound manual or loose/folded sheets; binding/pages cannot be resolved, so book is unclear. The surface is a computer work area rather than an identifiable dining table. After checking all 75 definitions, no other category is supported.

Stacks at the right show actual bound books with distinct covers and page blocks. A round wall clock at upper right has hands and a numbered time-of-day face. The tall white vertical structures are empty shelving or cabinet frames, not a refrigerator, oven, or bed. Folded gray/green textiles at lower right do not supply an identifiable chair, couch or bed part. All 75 exact definitions were considered, and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

This is a set dining table with breakfast place settings. The dark and orange drinks occupy identifiable stemmed goblets with bowls, stems and feet, supporting wine glass rather than cup. The foreground split pastry/roll visibly supports egg-like and darker meat filling, meeting sandwich. The fruit is on a shallow rimmed plate rather than an identifiable bowl; the bread container is a cloth-lined basket. Strawberries and grapes are visible, while pale yellow and green fruit pieces are too small/occluded to resolve banana or apple from other cut fruit, leaving banana and apple unclear. Reflective cutlery is cropped at the lower-left border without a resolved working end, so fork, knife and spoon remain unclear. The sugar/condiment containers have broad jar-like bodies and lids rather than bottle necks. Each of the 75 definitions was considered.

Actual baseball players are visible, including the batter, background player and catcher. The catcher extends a large fielding mitt with its pocket facing the batter, supporting baseball glove. The batter's small white hand coverings are batting gloves and do not independently qualify. Baseball bats, helmets, protective gear, cubby shelving and field surfaces are outside the other definitions; the ledge is not an identifiable bench seat. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Four actual people pose while brushing their teeth. Narrow toothbrush handles leading to the bristled/mouth ends are visible, especially the green-and-white toothbrush held by the rightmost person and the blue one near the center-left person's mouth. Clothing, belts and wall surfaces do not establish ties, bags, furniture, phones or other defined objects. I considered each of the 75 definitions, and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A pedal bicycle is identifiable from the frame, handlebars, saddle and spoked wheels. A flock of actual woolly sheep/lambs surrounds it, with recognizable sheep heads, ears, legs and fleece; these are not cattle, horses, goats, bears or plush toys. The background is unpotted vegetation, tree trunks and a path. All 75 definitions were considered individually, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual people stand beneath the wing and large exposed jet engines of a full-size airplane. A light-colored carried tote with blue handles is visible along the lower edge, supporting handbag rather than backpack or rigid suitcase. The woman near the center-right holds a small white open drinking cup at chest height. The blue rail across the foreground is a barrier rather than an identifiable chair or bench; badges, straps and clipped equipment do not establish neckties, phones or remotes. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.
